evidence.reason: New function reads capacity.occupied and capacity.available from intervals.capacity(minutes, 0.1, "room").
Changed to read capacity.used instead of capacity.occupied; if capacity.used is undefined, roomPressure returns NaN and any caller relying on it breaks.
Shared dependency: roomSummary calls capacity forward, and capacity calls roomPressure backward, so both edits converge on the same capacity result shape.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动都依赖 intervals.capacity 返回对象的属性，但缺少调用方、测试和注释证据，无法确认 capacity.used 是否存在以及 roomPressure 的返回值是否被 capacity 消费，因此只能给出警告。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/availability.ts#roomPressure 的维护者确认 capacity.used 是否为 intervals.capacity 的合法属性；若不是，应改回 capacity.occupied，或同步修改 src/intervals.ts#capacity 使其返回 used 字段。
